s: Din mi shehilva al chametz ubo t"z seipim: yisrael shehilva leyisrael chabero venatan lo halloveh mashkon shel chametz, ben shemmishkeno beyado bishat halvaa ben leachar kak, veamar im lo epra lizman peloni tigbeh chobeka mimmashkon zeh shebbeyadeka, ap al pi sheqqaba lo zeman peraon leachar happesach — ap al pi ken kesheyyaggia happesach chayyab lebaer mashkono min hattora, veim eno mebaaro — ober alayv be"bal yeraeh". Ap al pi shehitna im halloveh sheim yigganeb mimmennu hammashkon o yobad qodem sheyyaggia zeman peraon lo yitchayyeb beacharayuto veyipra lo kol chobo mishshalem, mikkol maqom kevan shekkol zeman shehammashkon hu beyad hammalveh hu qanuy lo vahare hu keshello lekol dabar, leqaddesh bo et haishsha veliqnot bo abadim veqarqaot, kemo shennitbaer beeben haezer siman k"ch, sheyyisrael miyyisrael qoneh mashkon miggezerat hakkatub, lepikak hu ober alayv keillu haya shello mammash (veketzad yitnaheg bebiuro? Ayyen besiman tm"g):

Nokri shehilva leyisrael venatan lo hayyisrael mashkon shel chametz, veamar lo: meakshav yehe kol chametz zeh shelleka bemattana o bimkira gemura bead hammaot shennatatta li im lo epra otah leka lizman peloni, ap al pi shehitna immo hannokri sheim yigganeb mimmennu hammashkon o yobad lo yitchayyeb beacharayuto, venimtza shekkol zeman shello para lo hu beacharayut hayyisrael, ap al pi ken kesheyyaggia happesach en hayyisrael tzarik lipdoto mehannokri kede lebaaro. Ap al pi shezzeman happeraon sheqqaba lannokri hu leachar happesach, vekol yeme happesach adayin hechametz hu beacharayut hayyisrael, mikkol maqom im akshav bizman biur chametz daat hayyisrael hu shello lipdot chametzo miyyad hannokri bizman sheqqaba lo lipdoto mimmennu, nimtza shellemaprea haya kol hechametz shel hannokri mishshaa shemmishkeno beyado vaelak, shehare amar lo hayyisrael: meakshav yihyeh kullo shelleka im lo epdennu mimmeka bizman peloni, ulepikak hare zeh domeh limqabbel alayv acharayut al chametzo shel nokri hammunnach bebeto shel nokri, sheeno ober alayv kelum, kemo shennitbaer besiman t"m:

Veim nimlak hayyisrael leachar happesach upedao mimmennu bazzeman sheqqebao lo — nimtza shellemaprea haya chametz zeh shel hayyisrael kol yeme happesach, veabar alayv be"bal yimmatze", lepikak hu asur baakila ubahanaa lekol adam miyyisrael kishar chametz shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach:

Abal im lo amar lo hayyisrael "meakshav yihyeh kullo shelleka", ella mishkeno etzlo bistam, veamar lo: "im lo epra leka lizman peloni yihyeh kullo shelleka", ap al pi shekkebar higgia zeman happeraon qodem happesach velo para lo, venimtza shekkebar nechlat hechametz lehannokri qodem happesach, shehare ap im hayyisrael rotzeh lipdoto miyyad hannokri leachar sheabar hazzeman eno yakol lehotzio mimmennu baal korcho bedinehem, mikkol maqom kevan shebbedine yisrael yakol lipdoto ap leachar hazzeman, dekevan shello amar lo "meakshav yehe shelleka" — hare zeh asmakta bealma,*[perush, shessamak bedato shebbevadday yipdennu mimmennu bizmanno veal hassemak zeh amar sheim lo yipdennu bizmanno yehe qanuy lo lachalutin, veim haya yodea shellebassop lo yehe sippeq beyado lipdoto bizmanno lo haya omer lo kak, venimtza shehaqnaato hayeta betaut umeolam lo gamar belibbo lehaqnoto lo lachalutin. Mah sheen ken kesheamar lo "meakshav", bevadday gamar belibbo lehaqnot lo im lo yipdennu bizmanno, mittaam shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman r"z, ayyen sham]. Venimtza shechametz zeh eno qanuy lehannokri middin tora, shehare hayyisrael yakol lipdoto mimmennu leolam, veen lo bo ella shibud al chobo vegup hechametz hu shel yisrael, shehannokri en qoneh mashkon miyyisrael. Lepikak chametz zeh leachar happesach hu asur bahanaa lekol adam miyyisrael, dehaynu sheasur lekol adam liqnoto min hannokri, shehare hayyisrael baal hechametz ober alayv be"bal yimmatze", vahare dino kishar chametz shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach. Abal yisrael baal hechametz chayyab lipdoto mehannokri ulebaaro min haolam legamre, shehare hu chayyab lehannokri maot, veal yede chametz zeh haasur bahanaa shennechlat beyad hannokri hu niptar mechobo, nimtza shehu porea chobo meissure hanaa:

Vekol zeh keshehechametz hu shaveh yoter mimmah shehu chayyab lehannokri, sheaz yesh bo din asmakta, abal im en hechametz shaveh ella kede chobo, yesh omerim sheen bo din asmakta, mittaam shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman r"z, ulepikak im kebar higgia zeman peraon qodem happesach velo para lo bizmanno hare kebar niqna hechametz lehannokri middin tora, vahare zeh kachametzo shel nokri sheabar alayv happesach shehu muttar apillu baakila. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem beissur chametz sheabar alayv happesach sheeno ella middibre soperim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"ch:

Veim hiqna hayyisrael et hechametz hazzeh lenokri qodem happesach beqinyan gamur hammoil sheyyihyeh kullo chalut lo bead chobo velo yakol lipdoto mimmennu beal korcho leolam, kegon sheamar lo qodem happesach: "kol chametzi shettachat yadeka hareni noteno leka bemattana gemura o bimkira bead hammaot shehilveta li", o sheamar lo: "yehe kullo shelleka bead chobi", shebbaamira zo niqna kol hechametz lehannokri ap shehu yoter mikkede chobo, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman a"g, lepikak apillu im lo higgia zeman peraon ad leachar happesach vehalak hayyisrael baal hechametz upada chametzo miyyad hannokri shennitratztza lehachaziro lo — hare chametz zeh muttar apillu baakila, shehare kol yeme happesach haya qanuy lehannokri lachalutin:

Vekol zeh keshechametz hazzeh haya munnach birshut hannokri kol yeme happesach, abal im haya munnach birshut yisrael, shello mishkeno beyad hannokri meolam, ap al pi sheamar lo "meakshav yehe kullo shelleka im lo epra leka lizman peraon", vaapillu higgia hazzeman qodem happesach velo para lo ukebar niqna hechametz lannokri lachalutin, mikkol maqom kevan shehu munnach birshut hayyisrael hare hu chayyab beacharayuto middin tora, sheim yigganeb o yobad mimmennu yitchayyeb liproa lo kol chobo mishshalem, shehare lo amar lo "lo yehe leka peraon raq mizzeh hechametz", ella lava mimmennu bistam, ubehalvaa zo nishtabedu kol nikse hayyisrael lepiron chobo. Veap al pi shehayyisrael hiqna lo hechametz beim shello yipra lo bizmanno, mikkol maqom behaqnaa zo lo nipqa shibudo mishshear nekasayv, vekevan sheim yigganeb mimmennu hechametz o yobad chal hahepsed al hayyisrael — hare hu keshello vechayyab lebaaro beereb pesach min hattora. Veim lo biaro — hare hu asur bahanaa leachar happesach kedin chametz shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach. Veim ba hannokri littol oto — mechuyyab hayyisrael lipdoto miyyado ulebaaro velo yannichennu littol oto, shello yehe porea chobo beissure hanaa, kemo shennitbaer:

Abal im hitna hayyisrael im hannokri sheim yigganeb mimmennu hechametz o yobad lo yitchayyeb hu beacharayuto ella hannokri yapsid chobo — eno tzarik lebaaro, vahare dino keillu haya munnach birshut hannokri kol yeme happesach, veal derek shennitbaer lemala:

Veim hiqna hayyisrael et hechametz lehannokri qodem happesach beqinyan gamur hammoil lehaqnoto lehannokri et hechametz sheyyihyeh qanuy lo lachalutin ap keshehu munnach adayin birshut hayyisrael, kegon shehiqna lo al yede qinyan sudar o aggab qarqa (kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman qtz"h ver"h ver"b, veayyen sham besiman qtz"d) — hare dino keillu lo haya chametzo shel hayyisrael meolam, kevan shekkebar niqna lehannokri lachalutin qodem happesach. Ulepikak, ap al pi shebbeshaa shehilva lo hannokri amar lo hayyisrael: "im lo epra leka lizman peloni tigbeh mimmenni chobeka meoto zeman vaelak vehammotar yihyeh shelli", velo higgia zeman ad leachar happesach, ukeshehiggia zeman para lo chobo venitratztza hannokri lehanniach lo chametzo — hare chametz zeh muttar bahanaa, kevan shello abar alayv hayyisrael kelum, shehare kebar hiqna oto lehannokri beqinyan gamur qodem happesach bead piron chobo, im ken kebar nistalleq mimmennu ha[yisrael] mikkol vakol, veshub en acharayut hechametz miggeneba vaabeda beones al yisrael min hassetam, ella im ken qibbel alayv beperush acharayut hechametz miggeneba vaabeda beones, deaz neesar hechametz bahanaa kishar chametz shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman t"m. Veim hitna hayyisrael im hannokri shello yitchayyeb beacharayut mishshaa shehiqna lo vaelak apillu miggeneba vaabeda mechamat peshia shello yishmerennu yapeh kederek hashshomerim — apillu lekattechilla muttar lo lehashhot chametz zeh betok beto, raq sheyyizzaher laasot lepanayv mechitztza gaboah y' tepachim, kemo shennitbaer besiman t"m ayyen sham:

Yisrael shehilva lenokri umishken hannokri et chametzo beyad hayyisrael veamar lo: "im lo epra leka lizman peloni yehe chametz zeh qanuy leka meakshav", vehiggia hazzeman velo perao, ap al pi shello higgia hazzeman ad leachar happesach, vekol yeme happesach haya hechametz beacharayut hannokri, shehitna immo hayyisrael sheap im yigganeb mimmennu o yobad lo yapsid et chobo bishbil kak — hare chametz zeh asur bahanaa. Apillu haya munnach kol yeme happesach bebet hannokri bealayv, shechazar hayyisrael vehipqido etzlo, ap al pi ken kevan shehiggia hazzeman velo perao hare niqna hechametz lehayyisrael lemaprea qodem happesach, mishshaa shemmishken etzlo hannokri veamar lo "meakshav yehe shelleka im lo epra leka lizman peloni" — hare zeh kachametzo shel yisrael hammupqad beyad nokri kol yeme happesach (shehu asur bahanaa, kemo shennitbaer besiman t"m), lepikak chayyab hayyisrael lebaer zeh hechametz beereb pesach kechametz shello mammash, shemma lo yipra lo hannokri bizmanno, venimtza shellemaprea haya hechametz shello veabar alayv be"bal yimmatze":

Veim abar velo biaro uba hannokri tok happesach lipdoto — rashshay leqabbel mimmennu hammaot ulehannicho sheyyittol chametzo, veen zeh mistakker beissure hanaa, dekevan shehannokri podehu — nimtza shellemaprea lo haya shel yisrael meolam:

Veim lo mishkeno beyad hayyisrael qodem happesach, ella mishshaa shehilva lo ad leachar happesach haya munnach hechametz bebet hannokri veachar happesach holiko hayyisrael lebeto, ap al pi shehazzeman peraon sheqqaba lo kebar higgia qodem happesach velo para lo, venimtza shekkebar nechlat lo hechametz mehannokri qodem happesach, shehare amar lo "meakshav yehe shelleka im lo epra leka", veen kan asmakta apillu bedinenu, mikkol maqom kevan shello mashak hayyisrael et hechametz lebeto qodem happesach lo qana oto bedamim bilbad, dehaynu beotan maot shehilva lo al chametzo, lepi sheyyisrael minnokri venokri miyyisrael eno qoneh shum dabar bekesep bilbad ella bimshika, mittaam shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman qtz"d ayyen sham, ulepikak chametz zeh leachar happesach muttar apillu baakila. Vaapillu mishkeno beyado qodem happesach, im lo amar lo "meakshav yehe shelleka", ella amar lo "im lo epra leka lizman peloni yehe shelleka meoto zeman vaelak", velo higgia hazzeman ad leachar happesach, vekol yeme happesach haya hechametz beacharayut hannokri miggeneba vaabeda beones, shello hitna im hayyisrael sheim yigganeb mimmennu hechametz o yobad yapsid chobo, umiddin tora hayyisrael eno chayyab beacharayut hammashkon shel nokri shebbeyado miggeneba vaabeda beones, sheap beacharayut hammashkon shemmushkan etzlo miyyisrael chabero eno chayyab ella middin shomerin, shehu alayv keshomer sakar, mittaam shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman a"b, veen din shomerin lemamon shel nokri, shehare omra tora: "ki yitten ish el reehu", perat leshel nokri, lepikak ap al pi shehiggia zeman happeraon velo para lo venechlat hechametz beyad hayyisrael, mikkol maqom kol yeme happesach haya adayin shel hannokri, velo haya hayyisrael mechuyyab lebaaro meiqqar haddin, kevan shello haya chayyab middin tora beacharayut miggeneba vaabeda beones, vahare dino kachametzo shel nokri sheabar alayv happesach shehu muttar apillu baakila. Vaapillu raa hayyisrael middato shel hannokri qodem happesach shehu rotzeh lishqoa chametzo beyado lachalutin shello lipdoto mimmennu leolam — en bekak kelum, veen hayyisrael ober alayv be"bal yeraeh", ella im ken hiqna lo hannokri et chametzo qodem happesach beqinyan gamur hammoil shello yukal lachazor bo middin tora, kegon sheamar lo "chametzi shettachat yadeka hareni noteno leka bemattana o bimkira gemura bead hammaot shehilveta li", o sheamar lo "yihyeh shelleka bead chobi", shebbaamira niqna hechametz leyisrael, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman a"g:

Abal im kebar higgia zeman happeraon qodem happesach velo para lo bizmanno — hare kebar niqna hechametz lehayyisrael beqinyan gamur qodem happesach, shehare amar lo hannokri "im lo epra leka lizman peloni yihyeh kullo shelleka". Veap al pi shello amar lo "meakshav yihyeh shelleka", en kan din asmakta, ap al pi shehechametz hu shaveh harbeh yoter mikkede chobo, dekevan shebbedinehem zaka hayyisrael bekol hechametz, veen hannokri yakol lipdoto mimmennu beal korcho, shehare bedinehem en danin din asmakta, im ken ap bedinenu zaka hayyisrael, shekkak hu din hattora: im bau lepaneka yisrael venokri ledin, im yakol atta lezakkot et hayyisrael bedin tora — emor lehannokri: kak hu bedinenu, veim atta yakol lezakkoto bedinehem — emor lo: kak hu bedinehem, ulepikak chayyab hu lebaaro beereb pesach min hattora. Veim lo biaro ad leachar happesach — hare hu asur bahanaa kedin chametz shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach:

Vaapillu lo higgia zeman happeraon ad leachar happesach, vegam lo amar lo "meakshav yihyeh shelleka", ap al pi ken tzarik hayyisrael lebaaro beereb pesach, shehare im yigganeb o yobad mimmennu mechamat peshiuto bishmirato yitchayyeb beacharayuto, shello ameru: en din shomerin lemamon shel nokri, ella leinyan geneba vaabeda habbaim beones, abal lo leinyan habbaim al yede peshia, shehapposhea hu kemazziq bayyadayim. Ukebar nitbaer besiman t"m shellekattechilla tzarik lebaer beereb pesach ap im eno chayyab ella beacharayut geneba vaabeda habbaim al yede peshia:

Veim hitna im hannokri shekkol yeme happesach lo yitchayyeb apillu beacharayut geneba vaabeda habbaim al yede peshia, apillu lekattechilla en tzarik lebaaro im lo higgia zeman happeraon ad leachar happesach velo amar lo hannokri "meakshav yihyeh shelleka", raq sheyyizzaher laasot lepanayv mechitztza gaboah y' tepachim:

Yisrael shennatan chametzo lenokri bemattana al tenay shehitna immo: "im lo eeseh leka dabar peloni lizman peloni yihyeh kol hechametz qanuy leka meakshav", ap al pi shekkebar higgia hazzeman qodem happesach velo asa oto dabar ukebar nechlat hechametz lehannokri, mikkol maqom kevan shebbedinenu lo zaka hannokri bechametz hazzeh, shehare asmakta bealma hi zo shessamak hayyisrael bedato, shebbevadday yukal laasot lo oto dabar lizman peloni, veal semak zeh natan lo, veasmakta eno qoneh bemattana, ap al pi sheamar lo "meakshav yehe shelleka", sheen amirat "meakshav" moelet lehotzi middin asmakta ella legabbe mashkon bilbad, mittaam shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman r"z, ulepikak chametz zeh hu leachar happesach asur bahanaa, dehaynu sheasur lekol adam liqnoto mehannokri, shehare yisrael baal hechametz abar alayv be"bal yimmatze" im lo chazar unetano lannokri bemattana gemura qodem happesach beli shum tenay, veal derek shennitbaer lemala. Veim hechametz hu adayin birshut hayyisrael, shello netano adayin leyad hannokri — asur lo litteno lo, kedin kol issure hanaa sheasur litten oto lenokri. Abal im kebar netano leyad hannokri qodem happesach, ap al pi shehu asur bahanaa leachar happesach, ap al pi ken en hayyisrael mechuyyab lipdoto mehannokri kede lebaaro min haolam, shehare en maggia lo shum hanaa mimmah shechametzo nechlat beyad hannokri, kevan shello netano lo bead chobo ella betorat mattana:
